2607.02057.title: Prompt Coverage Adequacy
2607.02057.paper_summary: In recent years, it has become increasingly evident that large language models (LLMs) and autonomous agents raise the level of abstraction in software development by shifting the focus from writing precise procedures to expressing intents and goals. This paradigm shift introduces new challenges, particularly in how testing should be guided when prompts, rather than code, become primary development artifacts. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt Coverage Adequacy, a novel coverage criterion designed to support the testing of code generated from task descriptions. Prompt Coverage Adequacy serves as an analog to traditional code coverage, but operates at the level of prompts used in LLM and agent-based programming. Specifically, it measures how well a given test suite satisfies the requirements expressed in a prompt by leveraging the attention mechanisms of LLMs. We evaluate a simple instantiation of this criterion, based on attention boosting, across two datasets and multiple LLMs. Our results demonstrate that Prompt Coverage is associated with fault-detection effectiveness and can uncover over 30+% more faults than traditional code coverage when used to guide test generation. These findings suggest that Prompt Coverage Adequacy can serve as a foundation for developing testing metrics better suited to the emerging paradigm of LLM-driven software development, addressing the limitations of classical coverage criteria in this new context.
2607.02057.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，越來越明顯的是，大型語言模型（LLMs）和自主代理在軟體開發中提高了抽象層次，將重點從編寫精確的程序轉移到表達意圖和目標。這一範式轉變帶來了新的挑戰，特別是在當提示而非代碼成為主要開發工件時，測試應該如何引導。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了提示覆蓋充分性（Prompt Coverage Adequacy），這是一種新穎的覆蓋標準，旨在支持從任務描述生成的代碼的測試。提示覆蓋充分性作為傳統代碼覆蓋的類比，但在LLM和基於代理的編程中運作於提示的層面。具體而言，它測量給定測試套件滿足提示中表達的要求的程度，通過利用LLMs的注意力機制。我們在兩個數據集和多個LLMs上評估了基於注意力增強的這一標準的簡單實例。我們的結果表明，提示覆蓋與故障檢測有效性相關，並且在用於引導測試生成時，能夠發現超過30%以上的故障，超過傳統代碼覆蓋。這些發現表明，提示覆蓋充分性可以作為開發更適合LLM驅動軟體開發新範式的測試指標的基礎，解決了在這一新背景下傳統覆蓋標準的局限性。
